name: Cache / In-Memory Store
description: An in-memory cache or key-value store — also called Redis, Memcached, Valkey, ElastiCache, a session store, or hot-data tier — a fast volatile layer holding sessions, tokens, rate-limit counters, and frequently-read data. Fronts slower databases to cut latency. The place to look for the cache, Redis/Memcached, in-memory/key-value store, session cache, or the hot-data acceleration tier.
